SELECT MIN(CALL_DT), MAX(CALL_DT), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT PRSCRBR_ME) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT
UNION ALL SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT), MAX(WK_END_DT), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT PRSCRBR_ME) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY

WITH de AS (
  SELECT r.PRSCRBR_ME, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) AS de_trx_52w
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON r.PROD_NDC11 = m.PROD_NDC11
   AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
  WHERE m.MKT_DEF = 'DRY_EYE'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(r.TRX_QTY) > 0),
hd AS (
  SELECT p.*, de.de_trx_52w FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p JOIN de ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = de.PRSCRBR_ME
  WHERE p.DECILE BETWEEN 8 AND 10),
c AS (
  SELECT PRSCRBR_ME, MAX(CALL_DT) last_call, COUNT_IF(CALL_DT >= DATEADD(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date)) calls_90d
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM de) n_de, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hd) n_hd,
  COUNT_IF(COALESCE(c.calls_90d,0)=0) n_uncalled,
  COUNT_IF(c.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL) n_never_called
FROM hd LEFT JOIN c ON hd.PRSCRBR_ME = c.PRSCRBR_ME

WITH de AS (
  SELECT r.PRSCRBR_ME, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) AS de_trx_52w,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110') THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) lacrivia_trx_52w
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON r.PROD_NDC11 = m.PROD_NDC11
   AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
  WHERE m.MKT_DEF = 'DRY_EYE'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(r.TRX_QTY) > 0),
c AS (
  SELECT PRSCRBR_ME, MAX(CALL_DT) last_call, COUNT_IF(CALL_DT >= DATEADD(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date)) calls_90d
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT GROUP BY 1),
lastrep AS (
  SELECT ca.PRSCRBR_ME, LISTAGG(DISTINCT rr.TEAM, ',') teams_ever
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT ca LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER rr ON ca.REP_ID = rr.REP_ID GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.PRSCRBR_ME, p.NPI, p.PRSCRBR_NM, p.SPCLTY, p.DECILE, p.TERR_ID, de.de_trx_52w, de.lacrivia_trx_52w, c.last_call,
  DATEDIFF(day, c.last_call, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since, lr.teams_ever
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p JOIN de ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = de.PRSCRBR_ME
LEFT JOIN c ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = c.PRSCRBR_ME
LEFT JOIN lastrep lr ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = lr.PRSCRBR_ME
WHERE p.DECILE BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND COALESCE(c.calls_90d,0)=0
ORDER BY p.DECILE DESC, de.de_trx_52w DESC
